# Build locally with Azure SQL Database container, now in public preview

## What Changed

Azure SQL Database container: build locally, test continuously, ship to Azure. Today at Microsoft Ignite, we’re announcing the public preview of Azure SQL Database container—bringing the Azure SQL Database engine into your local development workflow.
